title: Primary-nav icon renders at the expected size across declared themes on the home route in a browser (e2e)
asA: operator relying on the iconography discipline the application-spa blueprint declares
iWant: an end-to-end test that a real browser navigating the home route of the shipped application observes the primary-navigation icon rendered at the expected size across every theme declared on the blueprint's browserSurface
soThat: the iconography discipline (application-spa-REQ-011: one icon set, consistent construction, semantic aliases) is verified end-to-end at a user-observable surface rather than assumed from component-library conformance alone

acceptanceCriteria.description: The icon at the primary navigation slot renders at the expected size across all declared themes when the app loads its home route in a browser. Verification navigates a real browser through the same production entry-point construction the app ships (no header-stripping harness, no app.inject substitute), reads the rendered icon's computed bounding box, and asserts it equals the blueprint's iconAlias size token for that slot. A rendered box that resolves to the browser default (or to zero) refuses ship with a per-theme diagnostic naming the observed and expected sizes.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the application booted through its production entry point with the primary navigation registered on the home route
acceptanceCriteria.when: a real browser loads / in each theme declared on the blueprint's browserSurface and getBoundingClientRect() is read for the primary-nav icon
acceptanceCriteria.then: the icon's rendered box equals the iconAlias size token for the primary-nav slot in every theme; a mismatch, a zero-size box, or a missing icon refuses ship with a per-theme diagnostic

acceptanceCriteria.description: A shipped component that references the primary-navigation icon by an alias absent from the alias registry named on TAC-208-application-spa-icon-adherence-probe.responsibilities[1], or that inlines an SVG for that slot outside the registry, refuses ship through the icon adherence probe with a non-zero exit code and a per-file, per-line diagnostic on the probe report. A component scan that carries no such violation exits with code zero and the probe report verdict records the ok signal named on TAC-208-application-spa-icon-adherence-probe.interfaces.runIconAdherenceProbe. Applying agent sets: the project alias registry path, the component glob, and the report directory the probe reads and writes.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the icon adherence probe wired as a delivery-ci-workflows gate with the project alias registry, the component glob, and the report directory configured
acceptanceCriteria.when: the probe scans the shipped component source once for an inline SVG violation on the primary-navigation slot and once for a reference resolving to a name absent from the alias registry
acceptanceCriteria.then: the probe exits non-zero on either violation with the offending file path, line number and offending name on the probe report; a clean scan exits zero and the report verdict records the ok signal

description: A boundary-path AC covering the icon-adherence probe refusal on inline-SVG or unknown-alias violations against the primary-navigation icon slot; the browser render AC binds the success signal, the probe AC binds the shipped mechanism failure path.
